debt_context.summary: Arm's-length buyer, but a pressured seller: BHR said (Jun 12, 2026) it would sell two or three more assets to satisfy its obligations on the termination of the Ashford advisory relationship, with net proceeds going to Ashford; its Q2 10-Q records a $480.0M fee liability. No formal distress.
No documented trigger: no foreclosure, receivership, lender-directed sale, named-hotel impairment or company statement of distress by Sep 29, 2026.

v1.1._note: v1.1: spread graded as our calculation using Braemar's published NOI definition on its published TTM hotel EBITDA. Other factors as v1.

spread.source_label: BHR Q2 2026 earnings release (8-K Ex. 99.1, Aug 5, 2026), hotel-level TTM ended Jun 30, 2026

noi_calc.definition_text: Net operating income is the property's hotel EBITDA minus a capital expense reserve of 4% of gross revenue.

spread.note: Four Seasons Resort Scottsdale, TTM ended Jun 30, 2026: total hotel revenue $80,453k, hotel EBITDA $28,316k (BHR Q2 2026 release). Braemar's sale release of Apr 30, 2026 defines NOI as hotel EBITDA minus a 4% capital expense reserve; NOI $25.098M / $372.0M = 6.75%. Braemar's investor presentations say 4% or 5%; at 5% the cap rate is 6.53% and the spread 127bp, the same score.

also_sources.label: Braemar NOI definition (4% reserve), BHR 8-K Ex. 99.1, Apr 30, 2026
